headword: {節足|せっそく}{動物|どうぶつ}

definitions.explanation: An invertebrate animal with a hard external skeleton and jointed legs. The group includes insects, spiders, crustaceans, and centipedes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昆虫|こんちゅう}→昆虫：05010_konchuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{節足|せっそく}{動物|どうぶつ}だ。
エビやカニ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{節足|せっそく}{動物|どうぶつ}だ。
examples.english: Shrimp and crabs are also arthropods.

examples.japanese: {節足|せっそく}{動物|どうぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{地球上|ちきゅうじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧だ。
examples.english: Arthropods are the most species-rich group of animals on Earth.

notes:
Composed of {節足|せっそく} (jointed legs) + ⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧ (animal). A biology term for invertebrates with a hard exoskeleton and segmented, jointed legs.
